name: ACD A-level breakout with time confirmation
note: Fisher's ACD. The opening range is taken over the first or_min minutes of RTH, the A levels sit a_mult * daily ATR beyond it, and an entry needs conf consecutive bars that both TRADE and CLOSE beyond the level - the dwell requirement that rejects the one-print stop run. The day is gated on the session open sitting outside the prior session's pivot range P +/- |P - (H+L)/2|, and a failed A entry is reversed at the opposite A level (the C point). The family's own exit carries the two exits the idea specifies as structural: the opposite side of the opening range, and flat by the bell. The breakeven move after A and the 3A target are left to the shared execution grid.
source: Mark B. Fisher, 'The Logical Trader: Applying a Method to the Madness' (2002) - the ACD method, A and C levels as an ATR-scaled extension of the opening range with the 22% of 30-day ATR figure for the ES, and the rolling pivot range P = (H+L+C)/3 with pivot differential |P - (H+L)/2|; documented at http://www.dacharts.com/templates/descr/ACDmethod.htm and https://news.cqg.com/workspaces/2016/11/mark-fisher-indicator

def _dst(y, mo, d):
    import datetime as _dt
    m1 = _dt.date(y, 3, 1)
    ms = 1 + ((6 - m1.weekday()) % 7) + 7
    n1 = _dt.date(y, 11, 1)
    ne = 1 + ((6 - n1.weekday()) % 7)
    if mo < 3 or mo > 11:
        return False
    if 3 < mo < 11:
        return True
    if mo == 3:
        return d >= ms
    return d < ne


def _et_minutes(bars):
    """Minute-of-day in America/New_York for every bar. UTC in, ET out."""
    off = {}
    out = []
    for b in bars:
        ts = str(b["t"])
        day = ts[:10]
        o = off.get(day)
        if o is None:
            o = -4 if _dst(int(ts[0:4]), int(ts[5:7]), int(ts[8:10])) else -5
            off[day] = o
        out.append((int(ts[11:13]) + o) * 60 + int(ts[14:16]))
    return out


def family_init(ctx):
    bars = ctx.bars
    n = len(bars)
    o = [float(b["o"]) for b in bars]
    h = [float(b["h"]) for b in bars]
    l = [float(b["l"]) for b in bars]
    c = [float(b["c"]) for b in bars]
    ctx.et = _et_minutes(bars)
    ctx.day = [str(b["t"])[:10] for b in bars]
    R0 = int(ctx.p.rth_open)
    R1 = int(ctx.p.rth_close)
    ormin = int(ctx.p.or_min)

    # ---- RTH session aggregates, opening range, session open ----
    sess = []
    pos = {}
    orh = {}
    orl = {}
    sop = {}
    for j in range(n):
        if not (R0 <= ctx.et[j] < R1):
            continue
        d = ctx.day[j]
        k = pos.get(d)
        if k is None:
            pos[d] = len(sess)
            sess.append({"d": d, "h": h[j], "l": l[j], "c": c[j]})
            sop[d] = o[j]
        else:
            s = sess[k]
            if h[j] > s["h"]:
                s["h"] = h[j]
            if l[j] < s["l"]:
                s["l"] = l[j]
            s["c"] = c[j]
        if ctx.et[j] < R0 + ormin:
            if d in orh:
                if h[j] > orh[d]:
                    orh[d] = h[j]
                if l[j] < orl[d]:
                    orl[d] = l[j]
            else:
                orh[d] = h[j]
                orl[d] = l[j]

    # ---- daily ATR and the prior session's pivot range, both from
    # COMPLETED prior sessions only ----
    wd = int(ctx.p.atr_days)
    atrd = {}
    piv = {}
    trs = []
    for k in range(len(sess)):
        s = sess[k]
        if k > 0:
            hist = trs[-wd:]
            if len(hist) >= 2:
                atrd[s["d"]] = sum(hist) / float(len(hist))
            p = sess[k - 1]
            P = (p["h"] + p["l"] + p["c"]) / 3.0
            PD = abs(P - (p["h"] + p["l"]) / 2.0)
            piv[s["d"]] = (P + PD, P - PD)
            pc = p["c"]
        else:
            pc = s["c"]
        trs.append(max(s["h"] - s["l"], abs(s["h"] - pc), abs(s["l"] - pc)))

    ctx.orh = orh
    ctx.orl = orl
    ctx.sop = sop
    ctx.atrd = atrd
    ctx.piv = piv
    ctx._acd_day = None
    ctx._up = 0
    ctx._dn = 0
    ctx._fl = 0
    ctx._fs = 0
    ctx._crev = 0
    ctx._lvl = None


def signal(ctx, i):
    d = ctx.day[i]
    if d != ctx._acd_day:
        ctx._acd_day = d
        ctx._up = 0
        ctx._dn = 0
        ctx._fl = 0
        ctx._fs = 0
        ctx._crev = 0
    e = ctx.et[i]
    R0 = int(ctx.p.rth_open)
    if not (R0 <= e < int(ctx.p.rth_close)):
        return 0
    if e < R0 + int(ctx.p.or_min):
        return 0                       # the opening range is still forming
    if e >= int(ctx.p.exit_min):
        return 0                       # too late to open anything
    A = ctx.atrd.get(d)
    oh = ctx.orh.get(d)
    ol = ctx.orl.get(d)
    so = ctx.sop.get(d)
    pv = ctx.piv.get(d)
    if A is None or oh is None or ol is None or so is None or pv is None:
        return 0
    av = float(ctx.p.a_mult) * A
    if av <= 0:
        return 0
    aup = oh + av
    adn = ol - av
    ctx._lvl = (oh, ol)

    # the dwell: price must TRADE beyond the A level and CLOSE beyond it,
    # for conf consecutive bars. One print through the level is not an entry.
    if ctx.c[i] > aup and ctx.h[i] > aup:
        ctx._up += 1
    else:
        ctx._up = 0
    if ctx.c[i] < adn and ctx.l[i] < adn:
        ctx._dn += 1
    else:
        ctx._dn = 0

    conf = int(ctx.p.conf)
    gate = int(ctx.p.gate)
    ph, pl = pv
    if not ctx._fl and ctx._up >= conf and (not gate or so > ph):
        ctx._fl = 1
        return 1
    if not ctx._fs and ctx._dn >= conf and (not gate or so < pl):
        ctx._fs = 1
        return -1

    # ---- the C point: the failed A, taken the other way ----
    if int(ctx.p.crev) and not ctx._crev and not ctx.positions:
        if ctx._fl and ctx._dn >= conf:
            ctx._crev = 1
            ctx._fs = 1
            return -1
        if ctx._fs and ctx._up >= conf:
            ctx._crev = 1
            ctx._fl = 1
            return 1
    return 0


def exit_signal(ctx, i):
    if not ctx.positions:
        return False
    e = ctx.et[i]
    if e >= int(ctx.p.exit_min) or e < int(ctx.p.rth_open):
        return True                    # market on close; nothing held overnight
    if ctx._lvl is None:
        return False
    oh, ol = ctx._lvl
    if ctx.positions[0]["side"] == "long":
        return ctx.c[i] < ol           # the opposite side of the opening range
    return ctx.c[i] > oh
